items.mainDefect: The patched I18n.translate lazy-loads only config.locale, and only ApplicationController loads the fallback chain, so jobs, mailers and rake tasks return 'translation missing' instead of the fallback text.

secondary.defect: The 'translation missing' result is frozen into the LRU cache under the same key a correct lookup would use, so it keeps being served even after the fallback locales load.
The translation cache key doesn't include the site default locale or the fallback chain, so stale fallback text is served after default_locale changes.

items.mainDefect: The lazy-loading translate loads only config.locale, and only ApplicationController#set_locale loads the fallback chain, so I18n.t calls outside controller requests return 'translation missing' instead of falling back.

secondary.defect: The 'translation missing' result is frozen into the LRU cache under key+locale+backend_id and stays wrong even after the fallback locales load.
